narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The stick is five and the gap is three, so the projection is two centimetres.
<bookmark mark='angle'/>The gap stands upright and the projection lies flat, at a right angle.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Sides at a right angle do not take away like that.

narration: <bookmark mark='one'/>The stick, the height gap and the projection make a right triangle.
<bookmark mark='two'/>The stick is the longest side, so the projection is never longer.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. A stick ten centimetres long has one end six centimetres higher. How long is its projection?
